whyStudy.title: Transform your future with Technology in Agroindustrial Business Management at the UAM
whyStudy.description: Learn to manage companies in the agroindustrial sector in a comprehensive manner. Develop skills in resource management, production processes, marketing and tactical decision making to optimize organizational results in the rural sector.

items.title: 100% virtual training with academic support
items.description: Study from anywhere in the country with a methodology that combines autonomous learning, collaborative work and constant monitoring by teachers specialized in the agroindustrial sector.

items.title: Business management applied to the agricultural sector
items.description: Learn to manage human, financial and technological resources focused directly on the dynamics and needs of agroindustrial and rural organizations.

items.title: Integration between production and strategy
items.description: Develops the ability to articulate the productive processes of the field with the tactical and operational decisions of a company, connecting marketing, logistics and planning.

items.title: Focus on sustainable development
items.description: Train yourself with a vision that integrates organizational management with environmental and social responsibility, understanding the impact of each decision on the development of the rural sector.

items.title: Duration of 6 semesters with practical focus
items.description: Complete your technological training in 6 semesters with a methodology based on the resolution of real problems in the agroindustrial context and applied decision making.

items.title: Study at an institution with more than 45 years of experience
items.description: Accredited, recognized training with high prestige in the educational sector.
